structured.feedback: The description is about 210 words, with clear Markdown subheadings, a separate features list and benefits section, and a call to action. It has no links or invented quotes, and it leaves out the "doesn't work" and painful-peel complaints. Its claims match the listing (charcoal, all skin types, rosemary and calendula, 2-3 times a week, 15-30 minute instructions). Minor issues: "helps lift blackheads" is hedged but still leans optimistic given the reviews, and one sentence is passive.
